// GnoMoji — Main Game Realm (game29)
// gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29
//
// game29 closes the game28 audit holes (see SECURITY_GAME28.md):
//   - claims and achievements need an ed25519 voucher from the server's claim
//     signer (a dedicated key, never the treasury), with per-player nonces;
//   - per-rarity rate caps still apply on chain, plus per-coin vein caps;
//   - the Gnome Pass costs real ugnot (OriginSend), withdrawable by admin;
//   - PvP commit/reveal is hash-checked, casino bets settle on chain;
//   - player state can be imported once from game27/game28, then locked.

package game29

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29"

// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var (
	admin    address // deployer; can set roles, prices, veins, migrate, withdraw
	operator address // server hot account for casino seeds (defaults to admin)

	// claimSignerPubKey is the ed25519 public key (32 bytes) whose signatures
	// authorise ClaimAndMint / achievement vouchers. Empty = claims disabled.
	claimSignerPubKey []byte
	claimNonces       avl.Tree // addr → last used voucher nonce (decimal string)

	balances      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → amount string
	claimBuckets  avl.Tree // addr → "m0:t0|m1:t1|m2:t2|m3:t3|m4:t4|m5:t5|m6:t6" (packed; lazy-migrated from old addr:r keys)
	veinMinted    avl.Tree // coinId → total ever credited by claims/rewards/migration
	veinMaxOverride avl.Tree // coinId → admin-set max (overrides the rarity default)
	veinOverrideActive bool   // true once any SetVeinMax has been called; gates the veinMaxOverride AVL read
	casinoRounds  avl.Tree // roundId → *casinoRound
	pvpLobbies    avl.Tree // lobbyId and lobbyId+":field" → string (see game_pvp.gno)
	pvpWagers     avl.Tree // lobbyId → "coinId:amount:creator:challenger"
	ownedTools    avl.Tree // addr → comma-separated tool IDs
	toolLife      avl.Tree // addr+":"+toolId → remaining life string
	lifetimeMined avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total mined string (real claims only)
	rewarded      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total credited by rewards (medals etc.)
	achievements  avl.Tree // addr+":"+achId → "1"
	dailyCheckins avl.Tree // addr → unix seconds string
	skillRanks    avl.Tree // addr+":"+skillId → rank string
	miners        avl.Tree // addr → total mined all-time string
	playerXp      avl.Tree // addr → cumulative rarity-weighted XP (uint64 string)
	lastClaim     avl.Tree // addr → unix timestamp of last ClaimAndMint
	blacklist     avl.Tree // addr → "reason:timestamp"
	banExpiries   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry (0 = permanent)
	guilds        avl.Tree // guildId → JSON{name, leader, memberCount, createdAt}
	guildMembers  avl.Tree // guildId+":"+addr → "1"
	playerGuild   avl.Tree // addr → guildId
	gnomePasses   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry timestamp string

	paused bool

	// Gnome Pass price in ugnot per 30 days (admin-settable).
	passPriceUgnot = int64(5000000)
	passRevenueUgnot int64 // lifetime ugnot received for passes (accounting only)

	pvpCounter   uint64 // monotonically increasing lobby number
	guildCounter uint64 // monotonically increasing guild number

	// Migration (game27/game28 → game29). Batches are idempotent (set
	// semantics + batch registry); FinalizeMigration locks imports forever.
	migrationFinalized bool
	migrationBatches   avl.Tree // batchId → kind
)

package game29

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{
	"tempered_grip",   // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"stone_sense",     // +0.5%/rank  (Nature)

// toolLifeSkillBonus maps each skill to its per-rank life bonus fraction × 1000.

// GnoMoji — Main Game Realm (game29)
// gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29
//
// game29 closes the game28 audit holes (see SECURITY_GAME28.md):
//   - claims and achievements need an ed25519 voucher from the server's claim
//     signer (a dedicated key, never the treasury), with per-player nonces;
//   - per-rarity rate caps still apply on chain, plus per-coin vein caps;
//   - the Gnome Pass costs real ugnot (OriginSend), withdrawable by admin;
//   - PvP commit/reveal is hash-checked, casino bets settle on chain;
//   - player state can be imported once from game27/game28, then locked.

package game29

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29"

// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var (
	admin    address // deployer; can set roles, prices, veins, migrate, withdraw
	operator address // server hot account for casino seeds (defaults to admin)

	// claimSignerPubKey is the ed25519 public key (32 bytes) whose signatures
	// authorise ClaimAndMint / achievement vouchers. Empty = claims disabled.
	claimSignerPubKey []byte
	claimNonces       avl.Tree // addr → last used voucher nonce (decimal string)

	balances      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → amount string
	claimBuckets  avl.Tree // addr → "m0:t0|m1:t1|m2:t2|m3:t3|m4:t4|m5:t5|m6:t6" (packed; lazy-migrated from old addr:r keys)
	veinMinted    avl.Tree // coinId → total ever credited by claims/rewards/migration
	veinMaxOverride avl.Tree // coinId → admin-set max (overrides the rarity default)
	veinOverrideActive bool   // true once any SetVeinMax has been called; gates the veinMaxOverride AVL read
	casinoRounds  avl.Tree // roundId → *casinoRound
	pvpLobbies    avl.Tree // lobbyId and lobbyId+":field" → string (see game_pvp.gno)
	pvpWagers     avl.Tree // lobbyId → "coinId:amount:creator:challenger"
	ownedTools    avl.Tree // addr → comma-separated tool IDs
	toolLife      avl.Tree // addr+":"+toolId → remaining life string
	lifetimeMined avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total mined string (real claims only)
	rewarded      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total credited by rewards (medals etc.)
	achievements  avl.Tree // addr+":"+achId → "1"
	dailyCheckins avl.Tree // addr → unix seconds string
	skillRanks    avl.Tree // addr+":"+skillId → rank string
	miners        avl.Tree // addr → total mined all-time string
	playerXp      avl.Tree // addr → cumulative rarity-weighted XP (uint64 string)
	lastClaim     avl.Tree // addr → unix timestamp of last ClaimAndMint
	blacklist     avl.Tree // addr → "reason:timestamp"
	banExpiries   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry (0 = permanent)
	guilds        avl.Tree // guildId → JSON{name, leader, memberCount, createdAt}
	guildMembers  avl.Tree // guildId+":"+addr → "1"
	playerGuild   avl.Tree // addr → guildId
	gnomePasses   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry timestamp string

	paused bool

	// Gnome Pass price in ugnot per 30 days (admin-settable).
	passPriceUgnot = int64(5000000)
	passRevenueUgnot int64 // lifetime ugnot received for passes (accounting only)

	pvpCounter   uint64 // monotonically increasing lobby number
	guildCounter uint64 // monotonically increasing guild number

	// Migration (game27/game28 → game29). Batches are idempotent (set
	// semantics + batch registry); FinalizeMigration locks imports forever.
	migrationFinalized bool
	migrationBatches   avl.Tree // batchId → kind
)

// ── Tool Tables (game29) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One ID scheme shared with src/lib/game/catalog.ts. Every ingredient is

package game29

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{
	"tempered_grip",   // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"stone_sense",     // +0.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"master_craft",    // +15%/rank   (Things)

	"deep_science",    // +25%/rank   (Things)
}

// toolLifeSkillBonus maps each skill to its per-rank life bonus fraction × 1000.
// e.g. "tempered_grip" → 100 means +10.0% per rank (100/1000 = 0.10).
var toolLifeSkillBonus = map[string]uint64{

const claimBucketSecs = int64(3600)

// claimRatePerMin[toolId][rarity] = max coins/min of that rarity the caller may

// ── Vein caps (game29) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Every coin in coinRarity has a vein from deploy: its max is the default for
// its rarity unless the admin overrides it. No per-coin init writes needed.

// GnoMoji — Main Game Realm (game29)
// gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29
//
// game29 closes the game28 audit holes (see SECURITY_GAME28.md):
//   - claims and achievements need an ed25519 voucher from the server's claim
//     signer (a dedicated key, never the treasury), with per-player nonces;
//   - per-rarity rate caps still apply on chain, plus per-coin vein caps;
//   - the Gnome Pass costs real ugnot (OriginSend), withdrawable by admin;
//   - PvP commit/reveal is hash-checked, casino bets settle on chain;
//   - player state can be imported once from game27/game28, then locked.

package game29

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29"

// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var (
	admin    address // deployer; can set roles, prices, veins, migrate, withdraw
	operator address // server hot account for casino seeds (defaults to admin)

	// claimSignerPubKey is the ed25519 public key (32 bytes) whose signatures
	// authorise ClaimAndMint / achievement vouchers. Empty = claims disabled.
	claimSignerPubKey []byte
	claimNonces       avl.Tree // addr → last used voucher nonce (decimal string)

	balances      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → amount string
	claimBuckets  avl.Tree // addr → "m0:t0|m1:t1|m2:t2|m3:t3|m4:t4|m5:t5|m6:t6" (packed; lazy-migrated from old addr:r keys)
	veinMinted    avl.Tree // coinId → total ever credited by claims/rewards/migration
	veinMaxOverride avl.Tree // coinId → admin-set max (overrides the rarity default)
	veinOverrideActive bool   // true once any SetVeinMax has been called; gates the veinMaxOverride AVL read
	casinoRounds  avl.Tree // roundId → *casinoRound
	pvpLobbies    avl.Tree // lobbyId and lobbyId+":field" → string (see game_pvp.gno)
	pvpWagers     avl.Tree // lobbyId → "coinId:amount:creator:challenger"
	ownedTools    avl.Tree // addr → comma-separated tool IDs
	toolLife      avl.Tree // addr+":"+toolId → remaining life string
	lifetimeMined avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total mined string (real claims only)
	rewarded      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total credited by rewards (medals etc.)
	achievements  avl.Tree // addr+":"+achId → "1"
	dailyCheckins avl.Tree // addr → unix seconds string
	skillRanks    avl.Tree // addr+":"+skillId → rank string
	miners        avl.Tree // addr → total mined all-time string
	playerXp      avl.Tree // addr → cumulative rarity-weighted XP (uint64 string)
	lastClaim     avl.Tree // addr → unix timestamp of last ClaimAndMint
	blacklist     avl.Tree // addr → "reason:timestamp"
	banExpiries   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry (0 = permanent)
	guilds        avl.Tree // guildId → JSON{name, leader, memberCount, createdAt}
	guildMembers  avl.Tree // guildId+":"+addr → "1"
	playerGuild   avl.Tree // addr → guildId
	gnomePasses   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry timestamp string

	paused bool

	// Gnome Pass price in ugnot per 30 days (admin-settable).
	passPriceUgnot = int64(5000000)
	passRevenueUgnot int64 // lifetime ugnot received for passes (accounting only)

	pvpCounter   uint64 // monotonically increasing lobby number
	guildCounter uint64 // monotonically increasing guild number

	// Migration (game27/game28 → game29). Batches are idempotent (set
	// semantics + batch registry); FinalizeMigration locks imports forever.
	migrationFinalized bool
	migrationBatches   avl.Tree // batchId → kind
)

// ── Tool Tables (game29) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One ID scheme shared with src/lib/game/catalog.ts. Every ingredient is
// mineable by the previous tool (rarity ≤ prev maxRarity). Repair = ceil(30%
// of cost). See REPORT.md §4 for the full progression table and §5 for the
// claim-rate cap table.

// toolOrder is the canonical upgrade path from hands to omega.
var toolOrder = []string{
	"hands", "starter-twig", "twig", "wood", "stone", "iron", "gold",
	"diamond", "cosmic", "plasma", "neutron", "quasar", "void", "genesis", "omega",
}

// toolRequires: BuyTool must panic unless the caller owns the prerequisite tool.

package game29

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{
	"tempered_grip",   // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"stone_sense",     // +0.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"master_craft",    // +15%/rank   (Things)
	"thorn_hide",      // +1%/rank    (Nature)
	"storm_surge",     // +1.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"workshop_lore",   // +15%/rank   (Things)
	"iron_discipline", // +20%/rank   (Things)
	"vault_keeper",    // +20%/rank   (Things)
	"precision_forge", // +25%/rank   (Things)
	"field_repair",    // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"deep_science",    // +25%/rank   (Things)
}

// toolLifeSkillBonus maps each skill to its per-rank life bonus fraction × 1000.

// GnoMoji — Main Game Realm (game29)
// gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29
//
// game29 closes the game28 audit holes (see SECURITY_GAME28.md):
//   - claims and achievements need an ed25519 voucher from the server's claim
//     signer (a dedicated key, never the treasury), with per-player nonces;
//   - per-rarity rate caps still apply on chain, plus per-coin vein caps;
//   - the Gnome Pass costs real ugnot (OriginSend), withdrawable by admin;
//   - PvP commit/reveal is hash-checked, casino bets settle on chain;
//   - player state can be imported once from game27/game28, then locked.

package game29

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29"

// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var (
	admin    address // deployer; can set roles, prices, veins, migrate, withdraw
	operator address // server hot account for casino seeds (defaults to admin)

	// claimSignerPubKey is the ed25519 public key (32 bytes) whose signatures
	// authorise ClaimAndMint / achievement vouchers. Empty = claims disabled.
	claimSignerPubKey []byte
	claimNonces       avl.Tree // addr → last used voucher nonce (decimal string)

	balances      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → amount string
	claimBuckets  avl.Tree // addr → "m0:t0|m1:t1|m2:t2|m3:t3|m4:t4|m5:t5|m6:t6" (packed; lazy-migrated from old addr:r keys)
	veinMinted    avl.Tree // coinId → total ever credited by claims/rewards/migration
	veinMaxOverride avl.Tree // coinId → admin-set max (overrides the rarity default)
	veinOverrideActive bool   // true once any SetVeinMax has been called; gates the veinMaxOverride AVL read
	casinoRounds  avl.Tree // roundId → *casinoRound
	pvpLobbies    avl.Tree // lobbyId and lobbyId+":field" → string (see game_pvp.gno)
	pvpWagers     avl.Tree // lobbyId → "coinId:amount:creator:challenger"
	ownedTools    avl.Tree // addr → comma-separated tool IDs
	toolLife      avl.Tree // addr+":"+toolId → remaining life string
	lifetimeMined avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total mined string (real claims only)
	rewarded      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total credited by rewards (medals etc.)
	achievements  avl.Tree // addr+":"+achId → "1"
	dailyCheckins avl.Tree // addr → unix seconds string
	skillRanks    avl.Tree // addr+":"+skillId → rank string
	miners        avl.Tree // addr → total mined all-time string
	playerXp      avl.Tree // addr → cumulative rarity-weighted XP (uint64 string)
	lastClaim     avl.Tree // addr → unix timestamp of last ClaimAndMint
	blacklist     avl.Tree // addr → "reason:timestamp"
	banExpiries   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry (0 = permanent)
	guilds        avl.Tree // guildId → JSON{name, leader, memberCount, createdAt}
	guildMembers  avl.Tree // guildId+":"+addr → "1"
	playerGuild   avl.Tree // addr → guildId
	gnomePasses   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry timestamp string

	paused bool

	// Gnome Pass price in ugnot per 30 days (admin-settable).
	passPriceUgnot = int64(5000000)
	passRevenueUgnot int64 // lifetime ugnot received for passes (accounting only)

	pvpCounter   uint64 // monotonically increasing lobby number
	guildCounter uint64 // monotonically increasing guild number

	// Migration (game27/game28 → game29). Batches are idempotent (set
	// semantics + batch registry); FinalizeMigration locks imports forever.
	migrationFinalized bool
	migrationBatches   avl.Tree // batchId → kind
)

package game29

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{
	"tempered_grip",   // +10%/rank   (Things)
	"stone_sense",     // +0.5%/rank  (Nature)
	"master_craft",    // +15%/rank   (Things)

// toolLifeSkillBonus maps each skill to its per-rank life bonus fraction × 1000.
// e.g. "tempered_grip" → 100 means +10.0% per rank (100/1000 = 0.10).

// GnoMoji — Main Game Realm (game29)
// gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29
//
// game29 closes the game28 audit holes (see SECURITY_GAME28.md):
//   - claims and achievements need an ed25519 voucher from the server's claim
//     signer (a dedicated key, never the treasury), with per-player nonces;
//   - per-rarity rate caps still apply on chain, plus per-coin vein caps;
//   - the Gnome Pass costs real ugnot (OriginSend), withdrawable by admin;
//   - PvP commit/reveal is hash-checked, casino bets settle on chain;
//   - player state can be imported once from game27/game28, then locked.

package game29

import (
	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
)

const realmPkgPath = "gno.land/r/g138gdmwj6heduu3st796lw6qqdwylgaxf7ty5gz/game29"

// ── State ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

var (
	admin    address // deployer; can set roles, prices, veins, migrate, withdraw
	operator address // server hot account for casino seeds (defaults to admin)

	// claimSignerPubKey is the ed25519 public key (32 bytes) whose signatures
	// authorise ClaimAndMint / achievement vouchers. Empty = claims disabled.
	claimSignerPubKey []byte
	claimNonces       avl.Tree // addr → last used voucher nonce (decimal string)

	balances      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → amount string
	claimBuckets  avl.Tree // addr → "m0:t0|m1:t1|m2:t2|m3:t3|m4:t4|m5:t5|m6:t6" (packed; lazy-migrated from old addr:r keys)
	veinMinted    avl.Tree // coinId → total ever credited by claims/rewards/migration
	veinMaxOverride avl.Tree // coinId → admin-set max (overrides the rarity default)
	veinOverrideActive bool   // true once any SetVeinMax has been called; gates the veinMaxOverride AVL read
	casinoRounds  avl.Tree // roundId → *casinoRound
	pvpLobbies    avl.Tree // lobbyId and lobbyId+":field" → string (see game_pvp.gno)
	pvpWagers     avl.Tree // lobbyId → "coinId:amount:creator:challenger"
	ownedTools    avl.Tree // addr → comma-separated tool IDs
	toolLife      avl.Tree // addr+":"+toolId → remaining life string
	lifetimeMined avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total mined string (real claims only)
	rewarded      avl.Tree // addr+":"+coinId → total credited by rewards (medals etc.)
	achievements  avl.Tree // addr+":"+achId → "1"
	dailyCheckins avl.Tree // addr → unix seconds string
	skillRanks    avl.Tree // addr+":"+skillId → rank string
	miners        avl.Tree // addr → total mined all-time string
	playerXp      avl.Tree // addr → cumulative rarity-weighted XP (uint64 string)
	lastClaim     avl.Tree // addr → unix timestamp of last ClaimAndMint
	blacklist     avl.Tree // addr → "reason:timestamp"
	banExpiries   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry (0 = permanent)
	guilds        avl.Tree // guildId → JSON{name, leader, memberCount, createdAt}
	guildMembers  avl.Tree // guildId+":"+addr → "1"
	playerGuild   avl.Tree // addr → guildId
	gnomePasses   avl.Tree // addr → unix expiry timestamp string

	paused bool

	// Gnome Pass price in ugnot per 30 days (admin-settable).
	passPriceUgnot = int64(5000000)
	passRevenueUgnot int64 // lifetime ugnot received for passes (accounting only)

	pvpCounter   uint64 // monotonically increasing lobby number
	guildCounter uint64 // monotonically increasing guild number

	// Migration (game27/game28 → game29). Batches are idempotent (set
	// semantics + batch registry); FinalizeMigration locks imports forever.
	migrationFinalized bool
	migrationBatches   avl.Tree // batchId → kind
)

// ── Tool Tables (game29) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// One ID scheme shared with src/lib/game/catalog.ts. Every ingredient is
// mineable by the previous tool (rarity ≤ prev maxRarity). Repair = ceil(30%

package game29

// ── Claim-rate skill headroom factors (game29 caps, §5 of REPORT.md) ─────────
// When on-chain skillRanks are available these are computed from actual ranks.
// Until then we use fixed conservative headroom = client-side cap maximums.
// The effective rate for rarity r = base_rate[r] × skillHeadroom[r].
const (
	// dust: +4 yield cap, double drop and hardening -> sim max 1.70x of the 1.01 cap; 1.75 gives margin.
	skillDustHeadroom = uint64(175) // ×175/100

	// Maximum damage multiplier: ≤ 2× → twice as many blocks per minute.
	skillDmgHeadroom = uint64(200) // ×200/100

	// Maximum drop-rate bonus: +30% → 1.30×.
	skillDropHeadroom = uint64(130) // ×130/100
)

// toolLifeSkillIds lists the on-chain skills that grant toolLifeBonus.
// Covers the Things branch (level 50) and the Nature-branch skills that also
// affect tool wear. Must stay in sync with catalog.ts SKILLS[*].toolLifeBonus.
var toolLifeSkillIds = []string{

	"field_repair",    // +10%/rank   (Things)

}

args:
❤️ Pour les Vacances de Mikecito 🌴☀️

Et si, ensemble, nous pouvions offrir à Mikecito des vacances inoubliables ?

Tout le monde mérite de s'évader un peu, de prendre une pause, de découvrir de nouveaux horizons et de créer des souvenirs qui font du bien au cœur. Parfois, il suffit d'un petit coup de pouce, d'un geste de solidarité ou d'un peu de générosité pour transformer un rêve en réalité.

Aujourd'hui, nous lançons une collecte de fonds spéciale : « Pour les Vacances de Mikecito » ! 🎉

L'objectif est simple : réunir suffisamment de fonds pour permettre à Mikecito de profiter de vacances bien méritées, de vivre de beaux moments et de revenir avec des souvenirs plein la tête.

Chaque contribution compte, qu'elle soit grande ou petite. Même quelques euros, mis ensemble, peuvent faire une vraie différence. Et si vous ne pouvez pas contribuer financièrement, partager cette cagnotte autour de vous est déjà une belle façon de participer !

Parce qu'au fond, les plus beaux cadeaux ne sont pas toujours ceux qui coûtent le plus cher. Ce sont ceux qui viennent du cœur. ❤️

Alors, amis, famille, collègues et personnes au grand cœur, mobilisons-nous pour Mikecito ! Faisons de cette aventure une belle preuve d'amitié, de solidarité et de bonne humeur.

Notre mission : des sourires, des souvenirs et des vacances pour Mikecito ! 🏖️🍹

🙏 Merci à toutes celles et ceux qui participeront, partageront et soutiendront ce projet.

Ensemble, faisons de « Pour les Vacances de Mikecito » une réussite !

Chaque euro rapproche Mikecito de ses vacances ! ❤️🌞
Imaginez une plage de sable doré, une mer turquoise à perte de vue, un ciel bleu magnifique et des palmiers qui dansent doucement au rythme de la brise… 🌊🌴
